essence: On contemplating the body in view of knowable emptiness, one is to remember pure consciousness as pervasive.
For the mind of equal taste, a form consisting of pure consciousness alone comes into being.
A hand bearing a pot of fearless nectar, full like the moon, is indicated as the form in view.
Worship is defined as the act performed by means of flowers, food offerings, and similar items.
The supreme Śākta virility, produced and blossomed as nectar, is the object described.
